limits: Drift remains a separate diagnostic path and cannot fully resolve cli/src Python imports. A clean result is not dependency closure.
The return template passes with all task obligations explicitly unmet; structural validity is not acceptance. MOD-COMP-09 is system-scoped and reviewed separately.
Backstage owner defaults to unknown. Generated exports are review diagnostics, not registered services or external acceptance.

--check-report requires every JUnit testcase in the supplied report to carry a single verifies property and 1:1 testcase provenance; existing multi-test brownfield characterization suites are bound via Evidence.artifacts rather than --check-report.

--check-isolation executes project code for components declaring standalone_harness and provided_mocks; compilation-unit remains test_scope: integration without claiming isolated provider-owned mocks.
